name: OpenAI

transcription.name: Transcription
transcription.description: Convert source audio to timestamped text.

settings.label: OpenAI API key

settings.description: OpenAI model used for thumbnails and images. Clear it to use the plugin's current default.

headline.en: A backup for words and pictures
headline.es: Un respaldo para palabras e imágenes

body.en: OpenAI transcribes when your first choice can't, and makes thumbnails and images from your style references.
body.es: OpenAI transcribe cuando tu primera opción no puede, y crea miniaturas e imágenes a partir de tus referencias de estilo.
body.pt: A OpenAI transcreve quando a tua primeira opção não consegue, e cria miniaturas e imagens a partir das tuas referências de estilo.
